name: Birthday reminders
author: Bulwark Mail Community
description: Upcoming birthdays from your contacts in the sidebar, reminders on the day and a few days before, a quick birthday greeting and, if you like, birthday events in your calendar.

widgetDays.label: Show birthdays in the next … days
widgetDays.description: How far ahead the sidebar list looks.

notify.label: Birthday reminders
notify.description: Show a notification on the day and a few days before.

daysBefore.label: Remind me … days before
daysBefore.description: 0 turns the early reminder off; you still get one on the day.

addToCalendar.label: Add birthdays to my calendar
addToCalendar.description: Keeps an all-day event for each contact's next birthday in your default calendar, so other calendar apps show them too. Turning it off removes them.
